chapter: New Orleans and the Robichaux band
title: Back in New Orleans with Desvigne and pickup gigs
summary: Played Desvigne's gigs at halls around town and subbed for the trumpeter in Celestin's band.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs

blocks.x: at that time how come you didn't go back to New Orleans what were you doing up in Chicago
